title: Is HE the reason why we have these dreams?? 👀🔑
content: 📍So as a frequent "Mall World" traveler, I've been trying to figure out why & how we all visit these same dreamscapes & I found this that might help steer us in that direction! 💡 The "inventor" of the American Shopping Mall, Victor Gruen, wanted to also include hospitals, schools, & museums to his invention, that would be what he called a "Social Institution". That could make sense why a lot of our Mall World dreams consist of a hospital, schools, museums, etc! 🏨🏥🏫 From the research I've done, he also has ties to quite a lot of architecture around the United States such as Marina del Rey which could also explain the "beach city" type locations a lot of us Mall World travelers go to! 😱 This guy has a lot of prominent works that he contributed to the architecture in and around America & even Walt Disney was a fan of his & supposedly got some of his influence from him. As we all know, Disney is a major part of American Culture as well so this could definitely play a part somehow. I also learned abt the psychological phenomenon called the "Gruen Effect" which a lot of big corporations still use to this day to trick us into purchasing more than we intended to. It is reported that Gruen did NOT like what his vision of The Shopping Mall had become after awhile & that he also "hated cars" & felt like it was a threat to humanity's wellbeing. 😳 (For some reason that makes me think of Elon Musk and his Teslas...👀) But it's quoted that he also "believed that American central cities could be revitalized by constructing expressway loops around downtown areas, routing automobile traffic into parking garages and creating pedestrian-only zones, free of vehicular traffic, on previously-existing streets." My Mall World dreams often consist of intricate freeways & highways, as well as parking garages & parking structures & I've seen that others on this forum have as well so that is also an interesting component! 🛣 🚗 Basically, I feel like something is up with this guy and like he might hold the key on why we astrally visit these same locations even though we don't know each other, have never been to the actual places in real life yet keep returning night after night. 🔮✨️ I tried to see if anything pointed at him having ties to The Occult or something else that could explain this phenomena but so far haven't found anything. It did say that his death was a "mystery" though & that he ended his days back in his hometown of Vienna & idk if this is a coincidence or not but he died on Valentine's Day in 1980 which is just a few days before I'm making this post! I've posted some of my findings and would love if anyone else could contribute to what might be a major part of this puzzle regarding the "Father of the Shopping Mall" & why we even dream of Mall World in the first place!
